findings.evidence: Cut list in the dbff837f digest: showing 40 of 114 removed units. The listed units (old quest skeleton, 4-8 week sizing, always-save, invented timestamps, conversation slogans) are covered by record rows s017-s038 and the accepted drops; the other 74 are not itemized.
findings.fix: Itemize the remaining 74 para: ids in docs/audit/recovery/ship-learn-next/record.md, or confirm each is a unit of a section row already there; do not restore motivational filler.

findings.evidence: Causal comparison (A/B test, before/after a metric): change exactly one variable. Creative or integrative practice (a first song, a portfolio site): declare one learning target; coordinated changes are fine when the goal or time budget needs them, but say the result will not isolate a cause.
findings.fix: Add the missing branch: when the source itself is a multi-change procedure (a tutorial's required sequence), keep that sequence as one rep and say it is not an isolating test, rather than splitting or combining it under the A/B versus creative rule.

findings.evidence: Worked review covers only the inconsistent-execution row: "Sent all 10, one reply, only 6 followed the template".
findings.fix: Add one worked line each for Not shipped, noisy outcome, and usable evidence so the other three table rows are as hard to misread as the one already shown.

findings.evidence: Steps fit the stated time budget; list only the resources this rep needs.
findings.fix: State the default when the budget cannot hold the smallest honest rep: shrink the artifact or say it does not fit and renegotiate, and never drop a required step to make the numbers match.

findings.evidence: Nine evals cover routing, noise, inconsistent execution, a failed repeat, chat-only and a reading-list refusal, but none asserts the creative/integrative branch (one learning target, coordinated changes allowed, result will not isolate a cause).
findings.fix: Add one eval whose source is a first song or portfolio site and assert a single named learning target, permission for coordinated changes, and an explicit statement that the result will not isolate a cause.

findings.evidence: Only a URL, a title or the user's memory of the content: ask for the transcript or text. If the user wants a plan now, give one headed `Provisional: not derived from the source`.
findings.fix: Define the precedence: a URL plus a pasted excerpt is content and goes to step 2; the provisional heading applies only when no source text was supplied.

findings.evidence: Shipped, execution inconsistent (skipped steps or days, or a partial run with some artifacts, such as 4 of 10 posts) | Repeat the same rep once
findings.fix: Say the row is taken when the missed share is material (about half or more, or a named step skipped throughout), so one miss in ten stays on the shipped-consistently rows.
